transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the first-year composition program's proposal to pilot an AI writing-feedback platform in two sections next term. As the decision-maker on this, I want to make sure we've gone through the proper review process before I make a ruling. Specifically, I need to hear from both the writing program and the privacy office regarding any instructional or data-handling requirements. Has that review been completed, and is there anything I should be aware of?

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, before you make your ruling, I should note that the writing program has adopted a pilot standard for this platform. It permits the platform only for formative feedback, requires an instructor to review every generated suggestion before it is released to a student, and prohibits using the platform to assign or determine grades. I finalized that standard this week, but it has not yet been added to the proposal packet, so you would not have seen it in the materials before you.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I should note that my completed vendor review identified two requirements that must be met before approval: the platform must use institutional single sign-on, and the vendor must sign an addendum stating that it retains no student prompts or submissions. I'm pleased to report that the vendor has confirmed it will accept those terms. However, I should be transparent that my review memo is still awaiting attachment to the proposal packet, so it would not have been visible in the materials you received.
